title: Rabbi Yehudah bar Nechemyah

paragraphs: In [Menachot 68b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.68b), Rabbi Tarfon was sitting and struggling with a question. Rabbi Yehudah bar Nechemyah said before him, “No; if you say—” Rabbi Tarfon fell silent, and Rabbi Yehudah bar Nechemyah’s face beamed. Rabbi Akiva said to him: “Yehudah, your face beamed because you answered an elder? I wonder whether you will live long.” Rabbi Yehudah bar Ilai said: “It was in the period leading up to Passover. When I went up for Atzeret, I asked about him, and they told me that he had passed away.”[^1]
